primitives.verbatim_quote: Soon an adventurous spirit discovered that he could so place his foot upon the ball that by pressing suddenly downward and backward with his toe he would drag or snap the ball to the man behind him.
primitives.assumptions: Negligible air resistance, rigid contact surface, instantaneous force application.

The foundational mechanics of snap-back and pass coordination form a dual system where the quarterback's role evolves from direct action to indirect orchestration. The snap-back mechanism introduces a discrete-time control signal that enables asynchronous movement of players. In GSE, this maps to a state transition graph where each snap-back event triggers a new node in the play tree. The strategic pass coordination extends this into a spatial-temporal optimization problem, where the escape velocity of the receiver must exceed opponent coverage thresholds. The evolution from direct running to passing reflects increasing complexity in agent interaction models, aligning with the shift from deterministic to stochastic play prediction in GSI’s Bayesian framework. Failure modes include insufficient force application in snap-back and misalignment between quarterback and receiver positions, both leading to reduced pass success rates.
